Bihar MLC Election Results: BJP ke sath dikhe do nirdaliy MLC | Rahul Raj | Banshidhar Brajwasi | N18V | Bihar News
Bihar vidhan parishad ka chunav jitne ke chand din bad hi nirdaliy vanshidhar brajvasi aur rahul raj ki sadasyata par saval khare hone lage hain..nirdaliy emaelsi rahul raj aur vanshidhar vrajvasi ki bijepi men shamil hone ki tasviron ne tul pakar liya hai..halanki bijepi ne is par saphaee dete hue kaha donon emaelsi ne keval bijepi ko samarthan diya hai..parti men shamil nahin hue hain..lekin aarjedi ka kahna hai ki donon emaelsi ko ayogy ghoshit kiya jae
